# Rusty

## Overview

## Appearance

Rusty is a cat who has crop-eared ears. Over time, he has lost an additional piece of one of his ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)_

## Personality

Described as a fighter by nature, Rusty possesses an inherently aggressive demeanor. His inclination toward conflict suggests he would frequently engage in fights if kept alongside other cats.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)_

## History

After being found thin, singed, and damaged, Rusty trotted close to Anne's heels as he followed her home, having recently fought and defeated the tobacco-king's cat. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopted the disreputable stray at Patty's Place, where he miraculously survived a chloroforming attempt and earned a permanent spot in the house. Upon Aunt Jamesina's arrival with her own pets, Rusty attempted to fight the newcomers, getting put in his place by the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat while engaging in repeated battles with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) before eventually becoming his close friend. He later contributed to a chaotic scene at Patty's Place when Royal Gardner's mother and sisters made an unexpected visit.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003), [v3 ch.Relationships P7](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P9](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0009), [v3 ch.Relationships P13](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), +230 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--rusty.md)

Rusty was reluctantly adopted by [Anne](../character/anne.md) as a disreputable stray at Patty's Place, earning a permanent spot in the household after surviving an attempt to chloroform him. He became Anne's beloved pet cat who shows affection exclusively to her. He resides alongside her at Patty's Place, sharing in the daily antics and routine of the home.

- Friend of — beloved pet cat who loves only her  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048), [v3 ch.Opens P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)</sub>

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

When [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) brought her cat [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) to Patty's Place, Rusty initially tried to fight him. After engaging in repeated battles, the two cats settled their rivalries and became close, sworn friends. Their bond grew so strong that they eventually shared the same cushion at home.

- Friend of — sworn friends who sleep on the same cushion  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>
